title: Device detection and occupancy monitoring for Airbnb hosts
summary: Minute offers an occupancy monitoring solution for Airbnb hosts that uses device detection sensors to track how many guests are in a property and when spaces are occupied, without requiring invasive cameras.
problem_solved: Helps Airbnb hosts monitor guest occupancy and enforce house rules without privacy-invasive camera systems.
why_valuable: Enables short-term rental hosts to protect their properties, verify guest counts, and optimize pricing while respecting guest privacy.
